title: ResearchTask v1
description: Frozen, domain-neutral research task envelope: problem, scope, resources, permissions, completion criteria, and allowed external effects. Domain-specific detail belongs in domain_context and is interpreted only by the matching domain adapter, never by the core.

domain.description: Domain label only (for example math, quant, ml, dl, engineering). Carries no domain semantics inside the core.

scope.description: Frozen time/data/object range. Free-form in v1; domain adapters may refine it.

resources.description: Frozen resource envelope (compute, budget, limits). Free-form in v1.

permissions.description: Capabilities granted to the task, for example read:repo. An empty array means no permissions.

allowed_external_effects.description: External side effects the task may cause. An empty array means none.

domain_context.description: Optional extension point for adapter-owned detail. The core stores and hashes it but never interprets it.
